description: Defines the class 'ocudu::pdcp_rx_metrics' which manages reception metrics for PDCP layer, including counters for SDUs, PDUs, latency, and thread-safe latency processing.

classes.name: pdcp_rx_metrics
classes.description: Manages reception metrics for PDCP, including counters, latency measurements, and thread-safe updates.

methods.name: is_enabled
methods.description: Returns whether metrics collection is enabled.

methods.name: add_sdus
methods.description: Increments SDU counters and bytes if enabled.

methods.name: add_pdus
methods.description: Increments PDU counters and bytes if enabled.

methods.name: add_data_pdus
methods.description: Increments data PDU counters and bytes if enabled.

methods.name: add_lost_pdus
methods.description: Increments lost PDU counter if enabled.

methods.name: add_dropped_pdus
methods.description: Increments dropped PDU counter if enabled.

methods.name: add_integrity_verified_pdus
methods.description: Increments verified PDU counter if enabled.

methods.name: add_integrity_failed_pdus
methods.description: Increments failed integrity PDU counter if enabled.

methods.name: add_t_reordering_timeouts
methods.description: Increments reordering timeout counter if enabled.

methods.name: add_reordering_delay_us
methods.description: Adds reordering delay in microseconds and increments counter if enabled.

methods.name: add_crypto_processing_latency
methods.description: Adds crypto processing latency to a thread-safe sum if enabled.

methods.name: add_sdu_latency_ns
methods.description: Records SDU latency, updates histogram, and min/max latency if enabled.

methods.name: get_metrics
methods.description: Returns current metrics snapshot, asserting if disabled.

methods.name: get_metrics_and_reset
methods.description: Returns current metrics and resets counters, asserting if disabled.

methods.name: reset_metrics
methods.description: Resets all metrics counters, preserving the counter for resets.
